description: This file defines the HL7Service interface for the OpenMRS HL7 module. It includes method signatures for managing HL7 sources, queues, errors, archives, and processing of HL7 messages, as well as resolving entity identifiers based on HL7 segments. It acts as the primary API contract for HL7 message handling within OpenMRS.

methods.name: setHL7DAO
methods.description: Sets the HL7 Data Access Object (DAO) used by the service.

methods.name: saveHL7Source
methods.description: Saves an HL7Source object to the database. Requires update privileges.

methods.name: getHL7Source
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7Source by its identifier.

methods.name: getHL7SourceByName
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7Source by its name.

methods.name: getAllHL7Sources
methods.description: Returns a list of all HL7 sources, including inactive ones.

methods.name: retireHL7Source
methods.description: Marks an HL7Source as inactive.

methods.name: purgeHL7Source
methods.description: Deletes an HL7Source permanently from the database.

methods.name: saveHL7InQueue
methods.description: Saves an HL7InQueue item, adding a UUID if null. Requires queue update/add privileges.

methods.name: getHL7InQueue
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7InQueue item by its ID.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7InQueue item by UUID.

methods.name: getAllHL7InQueues
methods.description: Returns all HL7 queue items.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueBatch
methods.description: Returns a batch of HL7 queue items based on pagination, status, and query.

methods.name: countHL7InQueue
methods.description: Returns the count of HL7InQueue items matching status and query.

methods.name: getHL7InErrorBatch
methods.description: Returns a batch of HL7InError items based on pagination and query.

methods.name: countHL7InError
methods.description: Returns the count of HL7InError items matching query.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveBatch
methods.description: Returns a batch of HL7InArchive items based on pagination, status, and query.

methods.name: countHL7InArchive
methods.description: Returns the count of HL7InArchive items matching status and query.

methods.name: getNextHL7InQueue
methods.description: Retrieves the next HL7InQueue item to process.

methods.name: purgeHL7InQueue
methods.description: Deletes an HL7InQueue item from database.

methods.name: saveHL7InArchive
methods.description: Saves an HL7InArchive item. Requires archive privileges.

methods.name: getHL7InArchive
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7InArchive by its ID.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an HL7InArchive by UUID.

methods.name: getHL7InArchiveByState
methods.description: Returns archives matching a specific migration state.

methods.name: getHL7InQueueByState
methods.description: Returns queue items based on their processing state.

methods.name: getAllHL7InArchives
methods.description: Returns all HL7InArchive items.

methods.name: purgeHL7InArchive
methods.description: Deletes an HL7InArchive item.

methods.name: saveHL7InError
methods.description: Saves an HL7InError item. Requires exception privileges.

methods.name: getHL7InError
methods.description: Retrieves HL7InError by ID.

methods.name: getHL7InErrorByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves HL7InError by UUID.

methods.name: getAllHL7InErrors
methods.description: Returns all HL7InError items.

methods.name: purgeHL7InError
methods.description: Deletes an HL7InError item.

methods.name: resolveUserId
methods.description: Resolves a user ID from an XCN HL7 datatype segment.

methods.name: resolvePersonId
methods.description: Resolves a person ID from an XCN HL7 datatype segment.

methods.name: resolveLocationId
methods.description: Resolves location ID from a PL HL7 datatype segment.

methods.name: resolvePatientId
methods.description: Resolves patient ID from a PID segment.

methods.name: resolvePersonFromIdentifiers
methods.description: Resolves person object from array of identifiers (CX segments).

methods.name: garbageCollect
methods.description: Performs cleanup of current memory usage.

methods.name: processHL7InQueue
methods.description: Processes an HL7InQueue item, creating archive or error record as needed.

methods.name: parseHL7String
methods.description: Parses an HL7 string into a Message object.

methods.name: processHL7Message
methods.description: Processes a HL7 Message object, saving contents to the database.

methods.name: migrateHl7InArchivesToFileSystem
methods.description: Transfers archived HL7 data from database to filesystem during migration.

methods.name: getUuidFromIdentifiers
methods.description: Extracts UUID from a CX array of identifiers.

methods.name: createPersonFromNK1
methods.description: Creates a Person (or Patient) object from an NK1 segment.

methods.name: loadHL7InArchiveData
methods.description: Loads archive data into the system from the filesystem.

methods.name: getHl7QueueItemByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a HL7 queue item regardless of whether it is in queue, archive or error form, by UUID.
